# Shapes and glyphs markup reference

Shape, Line, Rectangle, PathShape, and GlyphElement.

### GlyphElement

Receiver: `GlyphElement`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Foreground(Color value)` | `Foreground` | Sets the foreground color, backed by ForegroundProperty so it participates in the same inheritance chain as text-bearing ancestors. |
| `GlyphSize(double value)` | `GlyphSize` | Sets the glyph size in DIPs. |
| `Kind(GlyphKind value)` | `Kind` | Sets the shape drawn. |
| `StrokeThickness(double value)` | `StrokeThickness` | Sets the stroke thickness in DIPs. |

### Shape

Receiver: `Shape` and derived types (`where T : Shape`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Fill(Brush value)` | `Fill` | Sets the brush used to fill the shape interior; null draws no fill. |
| `Fill(Color color)` | `Fill` | Sets the fill to a solid color. |
| `Stretch(Stretch value)` | `Stretch` | Sets how the geometry is stretched to fill the available space; the default is None. |
| `Stroke(Brush brush, double thickness = 1)` | `Stroke`, `StrokeThickness` | Sets the stroke brush and thickness. |
| `Stroke(Color color, double thickness = 1)` | `Stroke`, `StrokeThickness` | Sets the stroke to a solid color with the given thickness. |
| `StrokeStyle(StrokeStyle value)` | `StrokeStyle` | Sets the stroke style (line cap, line join, dash pattern). |
| `StrokeThickness(double value)` | `StrokeThickness` | Sets the stroke thickness in DIPs. |
| `ViewBox(Rect? value)` | `ViewBox` | Sets the source rectangle a stretch maps onto the element, in the geometry's own coordinates; null uses the geometry's ink bounds. |

### Line

Receiver: `Line` and derived types (`where T : Line`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Points(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2)` | `X1`, `Y1`, `X2`, `Y2` | Sets the line start and end points. |
| `X1(double value)` | `X1` | Sets the X coordinate of the start point in DIPs. |
| `X2(double value)` | `X2` | Sets the X coordinate of the end point in DIPs. |
| `Y1(double value)` | `Y1` | Sets the Y coordinate of the start point in DIPs. |
| `Y2(double value)` | `Y2` | Sets the Y coordinate of the end point in DIPs. |

### PathShape

Receiver: `PathShape` and derived types (`where T : PathShape`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Data(PathGeometry value)` | `Data` | Sets the geometry that defines this path; null draws nothing. |
| `Data(string svgPathData)` | `Data` | Sets the path data from an SVG path data string. |

### Rectangle

Receiver: `Rectangle` and derived types (`where T : Rectangle`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `CornerRadius(double radius)` |  | Sets equal corner radius for both axes. |
| `CornerRadius(double radiusX, double radiusY)` | `RadiusX`, `RadiusY` | Sets the corner radii. |
| `RadiusX(double value)` | `RadiusX` | Sets the X-axis corner radius in DIPs. |
| `RadiusY(double value)` | `RadiusY` | Sets the Y-axis corner radius in DIPs. |
